question: Question linked to image # 1 Which of the following statements is FALSE with respect to the anatomical structure indicated by the blue arrow in the image?

options.opa: It is innervated by the median nerve.
options.opb: Its function is supination of the forearm.
options.opc: Participates in the stability of the distal radioulnar joint.
options.opd: It has its origin in the distal quarter of the anterior aspect of the ulna and its insertion in the distal quarter of the anterior face of the radius.

reasoning_chain: CHAIN: "Blue arrow indicates pronator quadratus" -> "innervated by median nerve" -> "statement is TRUE" -> 90%
CHAIN: "Blue arrow indicates pronator quadratus" -> "function is pronation of the forearm" -> "statement is FALSE" -> 95%
CHAIN: "Blue arrow indicates pronator quadratus" -> "stabilizes distal radioulnar joint" -> "statement is TRUE" -> 85%
CHAIN: "Blue arrow indicates pronator quadratus" -> "origin in distal ulna" -> "insertion in distal radius" -> "statement is TRUE" -> 90%
analysis: The anatomical structure indicated by the blue arrow is likely the pronator quadratus muscle. This muscle is innervated by the median nerve, specifically the anterior interosseous branch. Its primary function is pronation of the forearm, not supination. It does participate in the stability of the distal radioulnar joint and originates from the distal quarter of the anterior aspect of the ulna, inserting into the distal quarter of the anterior face of the radius. Therefore, the statement that its function is supination of the forearm is false.
